chapter.v:
Praise Yah! Praise
God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

Praise him
for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

Praise him
with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

Praise him
with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

Praise him
with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

Let everything
that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
